name: baton-framework
description: Baton Framework - Core component library for AI agent orchestration

scripts.build:ordered: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/cognitive-patterns && npm run build --workspace=packages/agents && npm run build --workspace=packages/knowledge && npm run build --workspace=packages/workflows && npm run build --workspace=packages/claude-commands && npm run build --workspace=packages/cursor-commands-core
scripts.test: npm run test:root && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:root && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:yaml
scripts.lint:eslint: npm run lint:eslint:root && npm run lint:eslint:workspaces

author: Conductus Labs Ltd
